title: Issue Deduplication & Root Cause
objective: Menggabungkan laporan yang sama dan menentukan reproduction, affected scope, root cause, owner, serta fix path.
limits: Fixture lokal dependency-free; register kosong tetap BLOCKED sampai laporan nyata masuk. Tidak membuktikan tracker eksternal, native GUI, hosted CI, credential/auth expiry nyata, signing public-trust, hardware, telemetry produksi, atau publikasi; gate eksternal DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
